propositions: The completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts on identical inputs (same ticket, code, criteria, comments), flipping between PASS and FAIL-with-unmet-criteria across runs within minutes without intervening changes.

The verifier's test-existence judgment uses unpinned LLM sampling and free-form agent search strategies, causing it to fail to locate tests that exist (false negatives on '...test' criteria), particularly when searches use semantic/regex patterns instead of literal ticket-id or symbol lookup.
Non-deterministic FAILs block legitimate closes and waste LLM budget; non-deterministic PASSes allow incomplete work to close, undermining the attestation integrity of the close gate.

The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar payload lacks recorded verify_at_sha, trace_id, and input context, making it impossible to diagnose whether two verdict sidecars had identical inputs or experienced code/tree drift from stored data alone.

Pinning model temperature to 0 (greedy decoding) by default in _verify_completion_inner and recording verified_at_sha + trace_id in build_payload provides sampling variance reduction and determinism observability.
